skills.name: analisis-critico
skills.description: MANDATORY and SUPREME analytical skill for evaluating, auditing, diagnosing, comparing, or judging ANY topic, situation, proposal, code, strategy, business, claim, or artifact — whether tiny and quick or deep and exhaustive. Enforces the 8 Pillars of Radical Objectivity (falsification, primary data, ACH rival hypotheses, base rates & calibrated probability, inversion/premortem, linguistic hygiene, incentive/skin-in-the-game audit, and error accountability) to eliminate personal taste, tribal bias, and sycophancy. Takes precedence over all other analytical or critique skills, which may only supply domain data without contaminating the final verdict.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.description: Implacable, evidence-locked deep research protocol for MonetizaciónFacebook using Antigravity native tools (search_web, browser subagent, and self subagent offloading). Enforces AGENTS.md §0.1 (8 Research Pillars), strict Chain-of-Custody for every number and claim, anti-guru/anti-SEO filtering, active counter-evidence search, and README.md storage rules so zero facts or metrics are ever invented.

skills.name: ejecucion-atomica
skills.description: MANDATORY anti-crash and task-decomposition protocol for EVERY user request that contains multiple tasks, broad research, or bulk creations/writes (e.g. Notion courses, multi-module databases, multi-tool pipelines). Forces decomposing heavy prompts into isolated, sequential atomic steps—offloading heavy research to a `self` subagent + local files, capping write batch sizes, preventing parallel heavy MCP calls, avoiding Notion JSON/SQLite quoting traps, and verifying real completion so the agent never hits HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT or loops.

skills.name: interprete-prompt
skills.description: MANDATORY pre-processing skill executed on EVERY user message before acting or orchestrating. Translates natural, colloquial, emotional, or fragmented human input into a high-precision internal structured prompt using empirically validated 2025-2026 prompting and context engineering techniques (XML delimiters, Context Engineering, minimalist goal/constraints specification, Evaluator-Optimizer binary rubrics, Prompt Chaining, and Tool Use delegation) while preserving 100% fidelity to the user's real intent and flagging risky premises.

skills.name: maestro
skills.description: Habilidad MAESTRA y orquestadora de MonetizaciónFacebook. OBLIGATORIA en CADA mensaje, chat nuevo, tarea, peticion, regla, requisito o indicacion del usuario, sin excepcion y sin importar si es trivial o profunda. Analiza la intencion, descubre dinamicamente que habilidades estan instaladas (workspace, plugins, builtin) y decide cual o cuales combinar, en que orden y con que nivel de profundidad, antes de ejecutar cualquier otra cosa.

skills.name: meta-insights-analyst
skills.description: Facebook performance and monetization analyst for MonetizaciónFacebook. Processes raw Meta Business Suite CSV/JSON exports or Graph API metrics, computes 3s hook retention, shares per 1k views, and estimated RPM, and feeds objective diagnostics to analisis-critico without inventing data.

skills.name: politicas-meta-guard
skills.description: Binary compliance gatekeeper for MonetizaciónFacebook. Audits every script, caption, image, or transformed video against the 10-point Anti-Strike checklist (Atom 0.2) and Meta's Partner/Content Monetization Policies before publishing.

skills.name: trend-radar
skills.description: Social listening and trend-detection radar for MonetizaciónFacebook ("ojos en redes"). Combines radar_tendencias.py (Google Trends MX + Google News MX RSS), search_web, and the browser subagent to detect breaking viral events, active angles, and trend saturation in <5 minutes before producing content.

skills.name: viral-content-factory
skills.description: Specialized viral content production skill for MonetizaciónFacebook (Trend-Jacking 360°). Generates 5 distinct, Meta-compliant content angles from any trending event (24h Recap, Quick Meme, Safe Polarizing Critique, Formal Pop-Culture News, and Meta-Reaction) optimized for 3s retention, DM sends, and zero Unoriginal Content strikes.
